title: Days after deadly quake, fresh 5.4 tremor jolts Tibet
summary_full: Fresh earthquakes struck Tibet shortly after a powerful 7.0-magnitude earthquake caused significant casualties and damage. More than 12,000 residents were evacuated as rescue operations continued in the affected areas. Chinese President Xi Jinping directed intensified search and rescue efforts while calling for timely medical treatment for the injured. Complications in relief efforts arose due to the region's harsh terrain and potential secondary hazards.
